name: Rameshc Metal Price Manager for WooCommerce
author: Ramesh Chaudhary

sections.description:
Rameshc Metal Price Manager for WooCommerce is a powerful WooCommerce plugin that helps store owners automate product pricing based on the current price per gram of Gold, Silver, or Platinum. By setting global rates for each metal and entering the product’s weight, the final price is calculated automatically—saving time and reducing errors.

This plugin is ideal for online stores that sell jewelry, bullion, crafts, or any items made from precious metals.

Automatically update WooCommerce product prices based on live gold prices and metal weight. The plugin retrieves current gold prices at regular intervals and supports different gold purities, including 24K and 22K.

You can configure price adjustments using fixed positive or negative values, allowing you to add or subtract an amount from the fetched gold price. These settings can be used to automatically calculate and update WooCommerce product prices based on the configured gold rate and product weight.

Designed specifically for WooCommerce, the plugin helps jewelry stores and online retailers keep gold-based product prices up to date with minimal manual effort.

External services

This plugin connects to third-party external services to retrieve gold price and currency exchange rate information.

Gold API

This plugin connects to Gold API (https://gold-api.com/) to retrieve gold price information for XAU.

What the service is used for:
Gold API is used to retrieve the current gold price, which is used by the plugin for gold price calculations.

What data is sent:
The plugin sends a request to retrieve gold price data. No personal information or user-submitted data is sent to this service.

When data is sent:
The request is made when the plugin needs to retrieve the current gold price.

Terms of Service:
https://gold-api.com/terms

Privacy Policy:
https://gold-api.com/privacy

ExchangeRate-API

This plugin connects to ExchangeRate-API (https://www.exchangerate-api.com/) to retrieve USD exchange rate information.

What the service is used for:
ExchangeRate-API is used to retrieve the USD exchange rate required for the plugin’s currency conversion.

What data is sent:
The plugin requests exchange rate information using USD as the base currency. No personal information or user-submitted data is sent to this service.

When data is sent:
The request is made when the plugin needs the current USD exchange rate.

Terms of Service:
https://www.exchangerate-api.com/terms

Privacy Policy:
https://www.exchangerate-api.com/privacy

Key Functionalities

  • Set a Global Price per Gram
    Define the current price per gram for Gold, Silver, and Platinum globally via the settings page.

  • Use Product Weight to Calculate Price
    Enter the weight (in grams) for each product or variation, and the plugin will calculate the price using the corresponding metal rate.

  • Automatic Price Calculation
    The plugin multiplies the metal rate by the product weight to set the product price automatically. No manual calculation required.

  • Supports Simple & Variable Products
    Works seamlessly with both WooCommerce simple products and variable products, with the ability to assign different weights per variation.

  • Easy to Configure & Use
    Designed for efficiency, accuracy, and ease of use—even for non-technical users.

Key Features

  • Global price setting for Gold, Silver, and Platinum (per gram)
  • Automatic price calculation based on product weight
  • Compatible with WooCommerce simple and variable products
  • Ensures pricing consistency and accuracy
  • Reduces manual work and potential errors
  • Ideal for precious metal and jewelry shops

Customization

Need additional features tailored to your business? We offer custom development to extend the plugin based on your specific requirements.

Available customizations include:

  • Making Charges: Add fixed or percentage-based charges.
  • Wastage Charges: Include extra costs based on wastage weight or percentage.
  • GST / Tax Fields: Add regional tax calculations.
  • Stone Weight & Price: Support for products with stone components and custom stone pricing.
  • Custom Pricing Formulas: Modify the price calculation logic as per your needs.
  • Extra Product Fields: Add new input fields for special pricing factors.
  • Frontend Price Breakdown: Show detailed pricing including metal, stone, tax, and more.

📩 For customization inquiries, contact us at:
chaudharyramesh480@gmail.com

Data Collection Transparency

  • To deliver better performance and support, our plugin connects with your site in a secure and minimal way. This helps us provide smoother updates, faster troubleshooting, and improved compatibility — all tailored to your setup.
  • Collected data is kept safe and used solely for improving plugin functionality.

Installation via WordPress Admin

  1. Log into your WordPress admin area.
  2. Go to Plugins > Add New.
  3. Search for “Rameshc Metal Price Manager for WooCommerce”.
  4. Click Install Now on the plugin named “Rameshc Metal Price Manager for WooCommerce”.
  5. After installation, click Activate.

Installation via FTP

  1. Download the goldrate-manager-for-woocommerce.zip file.
  2. Extract the ZIP file.
  3. Upload the extracted folder to /wp-content/plugins/ using an FTP client.
  4. Go to your WordPress admin dashboard and activate the plugin under Plugins.

Support

For support, customizations, or development inquiries, please contact:

  • chaudharyramesh480@gmail.com
sections.faq:
Can I set different metal types for different products?

Yes. You can choose which metal (Gold, Silver, or Platinum) each product or variation uses for price calculation.

Does the plugin support variable products with different weights?

Absolutely. Each variation can have its own weight, and the plugin calculates the price accordingly.

How do I update the metal prices?

You update the global price per gram for each metal in the plugin settings whenever the market rates change.

Will product prices update automatically when metal prices change?

Once you update the metal prices in the settings, the product prices will update automatically on your store.

Can I use this plugin for products that are not made of precious metals?

This plugin is specifically designed for products priced based on Gold, Silver, or Platinum weight. For other products, it won’t apply.

Is this plugin compatible with the latest WooCommerce versions?

Yes, the plugin is tested and compatible with the latest WooCommerce and WordPress versions.

1.0

  • Initial plugin release.
